title: DAY 1 — LESSON 3: SHARED GOALS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

options: A task assigned to one employee
An objective that team members work together to achieve
A personal ambition unrelated to the organisation

questions.prompt: Who is primarily responsible for completing an assigned duty?
What should you do if you cannot complete an important task on time?
options: Assume someone else will complete it
Everyone contributes through their roles toward shared objectives
Employees are responsible only for their personal success

questions.prompt: A colleague repeatedly neglects her duties and expects you to complete them. What is the best response?
options: Keep completing the duties without discussion
Offer reasonable help when needed and raise recurring concerns appropriately
